label: Contrapunctus 13
note: mirror fugue in three voices, rectus
title: The Art of Fugue, Contrapunctus 13, mirror fugue in three voices, rectus

sections.label: Episode 1
sections.summary: Soprano: free counterpoint. Alto: free counterpoint, in a sequence falling by a step every two bars. Bass: a figure from the subject, inverted (5 times) and a figure from the subject (2 times), in a sequence falling by a step every two bars.
sections.leads: From A minor to D minor

sections.label: Episode 2
sections.summary: Soprano: a figure from the subject (2 times). Alto: a figure from the subject, inverted. Bass: free counterpoint. Returns in Episode 3 (bars 41–47).
sections.leads: From D minor to B♭ major

sections.label: Stretto: Subject in B♭ major, rhythm varied (Soprano); Subject in B♭ major, inverted (Bass); Subject in B♭ major (Soprano); Subject in G minor, inverted (Alto)
Episode 3
sections.summary: Reworks Episode 2 (bars 24–26) in part, with soprano and alto exchanged, a fourth higher. Soprano: a figure from the subject, inverted (2 times) and a figure from the subject, in a sequence falling by a step every two bars. Alto: a figure from the subject (2 times). Bass: a figure from the subject, inverted (3 times).
sections.leads: From G minor to D minor

sections.label: Episode 4
sections.summary: Soprano: a figure from the subject (5 times), in a sequence rising by a step every two bars. Alto: a figure from the subject, inverted (4 times) and a figure from the subject (3 times), in a sequence rising by a step every two bars. Bass: free counterpoint, in a sequence rising by a step every two bars.
sections.leads: Between two statements in D minor

sections.label: Answer in D minor, inverted (Bass); Subject in D minor (Soprano)
